WITH poor_logistics AS (
    SELECT 
        de.affectedarea 
    FROM 
        disasterevents de
    WHERE 
        de."impactMetrics.transportation" = 'Limited'
),
boosted_supplies AS (
    SELECT 
        s.supplydistref, 
        jsonb_set(
            s.resourceinventory, 
            '{power, generators}', 
            (jsonb_set(
                s.resourceinventory, 
                '{essentials, water_liters}', 
                to_jsonb(resourceinventory -> 'essentials' ->> 'water_liters') * '2.0'
            ) -> 'power' ->> 'generators')::jsonb
        ) AS boosted_inventory
    FROM 
        supplies s
    JOIN 
        poor_logistics pl ON s.supplydistref = pl.affectedarea
)
SELECT 
    pl.affectedarea, 
    bs.boosted_inventory
FROM 
    poor_logistics pl
JOIN 
    boosted_supplies bs ON pl.affectedarea = bs.supplydistref;
